'''Afterburner Arches''' was a famous landmark on [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]]. Located off the coast of [[Prime Coromon]], the site was composed of three impressive natural stone arches.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
